channel.title: Medics Musings: Aging
channel.description: Growing older with a clinician’s eye and a comedian’s timing: senior pickleball, walker balls, retired burlesque dancers and the robots now helping with elder care.

item.title: The Robot Who Wipes My Butt
item.description: An 84-year-old meets Gerald, the hygiene robot with a 4.8-star rating, and learns that shame doesn't transfer to a machine. A funny, tender look at robots caring for seniors, and what they must never replace. (4 min)

item.title: Senior Pickleball: When the Spirit Is Willing but the Joints Are Not!
